paragraphs.intro: EscapeMate is an indie project for finding raid teammates. It is not officially affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Battlestate Games or Escape from Tarkov.
paragraphs.discord: We use Discord OAuth to sign in and receive basic data such as identifier, username, and avatar. Your Discord is only used as a contact method and is not shown to other users before a match exists.
paragraphs.profile: We store profile data that you enter in the app, such as nickname, region, languages, favorite maps, play styles, objectives, schedule, bio, messages, matches, blocks, and reports.
paragraphs.tarkovStats: If you sync Tarkov statistics, we use public data available from tarkov.dev or players.tarkov.dev. You can also save manual statistics if syncing is unavailable.
paragraphs.moderation: You can report or block users. Reports are stored for future moderation and blocks are used to prevent incompatible or unwanted profiles from appearing again.

paragraphs.intro: EscapeMate is offered as a beta to help players find compatible teammates. The app is not officially affiliated with Battlestate Games or Escape from Tarkov.
paragraphs.conduct: You must use the app respectfully. We do not allow harassment, spam, impersonation, RMT, external payments, service sales, cheating, or activity that harms other users.
paragraphs.data: Sign-in uses Discord OAuth. By using the app, you agree that we may store your profile data, matches, messages, reports, blocks, and public or manual Tarkov statistics if you choose to add them.
paragraphs.tarkovDev: Public tarkov.dev data is shown for reference and may not always be available or up to date. If tarkov.dev fails, EscapeMate can continue working with manual data.
paragraphs.moderation: We may review reports, block access to features, or close accounts if we detect abuse. The beta may change or be interrupted while we stabilize the service.
